name: @volt/contracts
description: Shared wire contracts (routes, request/response types, wire enums) consumed by VOLT server + client. Raw TypeScript source, no build step. There is no barrel: consumers import the concept file directly via the @volt/contracts/* tsconfig path / Vite alias. The ai-tools.ts files are the only runtime-valued modules here (zod schemas for AI tool inputs); zod is resolved from the consumer via its `zod` tsconfig path / Vite alias, so no node_modules lives in this package.
